odd_even_process_pairs.even_uncertainty_reduced: Substantially, but by redirecting the question rather than answering it as posed. Established with reproducible, independently verified evidence that (a) the as-implemented momentum signal is a static long with ~0.1 sign changes/yr, so its cost robustness is trivially COST_ROBUST and not evidence about momentum; and (b) the prior momentum 'SUPPORTED / lookback-robust / horizon-stable' results are confounded by this implementation defect. The uncertainty about 'does momentum survive costs' is now replaced by the better-posed uncertainty 'does a correctly implemented short-horizon momentum signal exist and survive costs'.
